userReport: The visible browser appeared stuck at Waiting GPU / ready and seemed to need a manual click or Enter to proceed.
confirmedCauses: Boot overwrote the completed frame status with Waiting GPU followed by ready, while development pages were intentionally paused without an explicit paused label.
Default browser readiness polling used requestAnimationFrame and did not have a separate Node deadline, leaving background/occluded test windows vulnerable to suspended RAF polling.
fix: Normal development pages automatically run; only explicit automation=1 development sessions pause, with an unambiguous state label.
Readiness uses numeric polling, a Node deadline and owned-browser cleanup; development launch options reduce background timer/occlusion throttling without bypassing GPU capabilities.
GPU adapter/device/renderer/content initialization and submission waits have explicit bounded errors.

realHardwareRegression.normalCoveredPage: simulation ticks continue without activating the game page
realHardwareRegression.automationWithRAFDisabled: readiness, three fixed steps and PNG capture pass on a non-fallback NVIDIA adapter
